title: Nag
simplified_paragraphs: 妻子正在做菜，丈夫在她旁边一直唠叨不停：“慢些，小心！火太大了……油太多了……水少一点儿！”
妻子生气地说：“你能不能回房间做自己的事情？我知道怎样做菜，不需要你来告诉我。”
丈夫平静地回答：“我只是要让你知道，我开车时，你在旁边不停地说话，我的感觉如何……”
traditional_paragraphs: 妻子正在做菜，丈夫在她旁邊一直嘮叨不停：“慢些，小心！火太大了……油太多了……水少一點兒！”
妻子生氣地說：“你能不能回房間做自己的事情？我知道怎樣做菜，不需要你來告訴我。”
丈夫平靜地回答：“我只是要讓你知道，我開車時，你在旁邊不停地說話，我的感覺如何……”
pinyin_paragraphs: qī zi zhèng zài zuò cài， zhàng fu zài tā páng biān yī zhí láo dao bù tíng：“ màn xiē， xiǎo xīn！ huǒ tài dà le …… yóu tài duō le …… shuǐ shǎo yī diǎn r！”
qī zi shēng qì de shuō：“ nǐ néng bù néng huí fáng jiān zuò zì jǐ de shì qing？ wǒ zhī dào zěn yàng zuò cài， bù xū yào nǐ lái gào su wǒ。”
zhàng fu píng jìng de huí dá：“ wǒ zhǐ shì yào ràng nǐ zhī dào， wǒ kāi chē shí， nǐ zài páng biān bù tíng de shuō huà， wǒ de gǎn jué rú hé ……”
english_paragraphs: The wife was cooking, and her husband kept nagging her from beside her: “Slow down! Be careful! The heat’s too high… Too much oil… Use a little less water!”
Annoyed, his wife said, “Can you go back to your room and do your own thing? I know how to cook. I don’t need you to tell me what to do.”
Her husband replied calmly, “I just wanted you to know how I feel when I’m driving and you keep talking beside me…”
english_full:
The wife was cooking, and her husband kept nagging her from beside her: “Slow down! Be careful! The heat’s too high… Too much oil… Use a little less water!”

Annoyed, his wife said, “Can you go back to your room and do your own thing? I know how to cook. I don’t need you to tell me what to do.”

Her husband replied calmly, “I just wanted you to know how I feel when I’m driving and you keep talking beside me…”
